name: openbot
description: Fork 100% local (Windows-only) do Grok Bot — shim de gateway HTTP+SSE + RPC sobre providers abertos (OpenAI/xAI/OpenAI-compat). Fase 1 (MVP).
author: OpenBot

scripts.test: vitest run --maxWorkers=10 --exclude test/release-lifecycle.test.ts --exclude test/data-recovery-live.test.ts --exclude test/keystore-dpapi-live.test.ts --exclude test/runtime-wsl-live-inventory.test.ts --exclude test/browser-e2e.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:full: npm test && vitest run test/release-lifecycle.test.ts test/data-recovery-live.test.ts test/keystore-dpapi-live.test.ts test/runtime-wsl-live-inventory.test.ts test/browser-e2e.integration.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --maxConcurrency=5 --no-file-parallelism && npm run verify:e2e:electron-ui
scripts.release:package: npm run build && npm run verify:backend-artifacts && npm run verify:dpapi-artifacts && node scripts/release.mjs
scripts.verify:clean-profile: npm run build && node --check scripts/verify-clean-profile.mjs && node scripts/verify-clean-profile.mjs
scripts.verify:chat-resilience: npm run typecheck && vitest run test/provider-regressions.test.ts test/router.test.ts test/rpc-send.test.ts test/store.test.ts test/turn-crash-recovery.test.ts test/rpc-send-gateway.integration.test.ts test/electron-windows-patches.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.verify:bot-memory: npm run typecheck && vitest run test/conversations.test.ts test/conversation-runtime.integration.test.ts test/memory-core.test.ts test/memory-context.test.ts test/memory-reflection.integration.test.ts test/electron-conversation-memory-ui.test.ts test/electron-launch-scripts.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism && npm run verify:client-artifacts && node scripts/bridge-real-verify.mjs && npm run verify:memory-flow-e2e
scripts.verify:memory-flow-e2e: npm run build && node --check scripts/memory-flow-e2e.mjs && node scripts/memory-flow-e2e.mjs
scripts.audit:browser: npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/openbot-audit-browser.ps1
scripts.verify:core:acceptance: npm run typecheck && vitest run test/core-acceptance.integration.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.verify:e2e:browser: npm run build && vitest run test/browser-e2e.integration.test.ts test/browser-security.test.ts test/browser-host-fatal.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.verify:e2e:desktop: npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/e2e-desktop-run.ps1
scripts.verify:acl:live: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:OPENBOT_RUN_LIVE_ACL_TEST='1'; npm exec -- vitest run test/home-acl.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
